text: 2026浦江创新论坛开幕式9月12日举行，上海（长三角）国际科技创新中心建设阶段成果以视频形式发布。其中提到，上海发挥龙头带动作用，苏浙皖各扬所长，三省一市共享资源、共建平台、共育生态、共推改革，科技创新策源能力、高端产业引领能力、顶尖人才集聚能力加快提升，国际科技创新中心建设从单城突破迈向长三角区域协同一体化发展的新阶段。（证券时报）
text_en: The opening ceremony of the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum was held on September 12, where the phased achievements of building Shanghai (Yangtze River Delta) as an international center for science and technology innovation were released in video form. It was mentioned that Shanghai plays a leading and driving role, while Jiangsu, Zhejiang and Anhui each leverage their respective strengths. The three provinces and one municipality share resources, jointly build platforms, jointly cultivate ecosystems and jointly promote reform. Their capacity for scientific and technological innovation sourcing, high-end industry leadership and top talent aggregation is accelerating. The construction of the international center for science and technology innovation has moved from a single-city breakthrough to a new stage of coordinated and integrated development across the Yangtze River Delta region. (Securities Times)
